verdict.rationale: Martin is a personal AI assistant, so interpreting shared screenshots and photos is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack only documents calendar, email, Slack, reminders, to-dos, notes, search and voice/SMS channels, with no mention of image input or visual understanding. Forwarding emails and reading messages cover text content, not image interpretation.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can share screenshots and photos and have the assistant accurately interpret what is in them
